test_nmf_fit_nn_output: test the NMF and MiniBatchNMF estimators produce non-negative decomposition outputs for all solver and initialization combinations
test_nmf_transform: test the NMF transform method returns values consistent with fit_transform for both cd and mu solvers
test_nmf_sparse_input: test that NMF and MiniBatchNMF produce identical results when given sparse or dense input matrices
test_nmf_regularization: test that L1 regularization increases sparsity and L2 regularization decreases squared norm in NMF decomposition
test_nmf_decreasing: test that the NMF objective function decreases monotonically at each iteration for all valid beta_loss values
